places.name: Lund Cathedral
places.ai_summary: A historic cathedral known for its Romanesque architecture, astronomical clock, and serene atmosphere.

opening_hours.notes: Special hours during services and events.

places.place_tip: Don’t miss the astronomical clock show at noon.

places.name: Lund University Main Building
places.ai_summary: An iconic building of Lund University, showcasing neoclassical architecture and surrounded by lush gardens.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on public holidays.

places.place_tip: Take a guided tour to learn about the university’s history.

places.name: Botanical Garden (Botaniska Trädgården)
places.ai_summary: A beautiful garden displaying a wide variety of plants, trees, and flowers, with walking paths and a pond.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Midsummer Eve and Christmas Eve.

places.place_tip: Visit the tropical greenhouse for a unique plant experience.

places.name: Kulturen Open-Air Museum
places.ai_summary: A cultural history museum in an open-air setting, featuring historical buildings and exhibits from the region.

opening_hours.notes: Last admission one hour before closing.

places.place_tip: Join a guided tour for in-depth knowledge of the exhibits.

places.name: Lund Observatory
places.ai_summary: An astronomical observatory offering public viewing nights and educational programs about the universe.

opening_hours.notes: Open only during scheduled events.

places.place_tip: Check the schedule for public viewing nights and special events.

places.name: Skissernas Museum (Museum of Artistic Process)
places.ai_summary: A unique museum dedicated to the artistic process, featuring sketches, models, and installations by renowned artists.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on public holidays.

places.place_tip: Explore the museum shop for unique art-inspired souvenirs.

places.name: Lundagård Park
places.ai_summary: A picturesque park in the heart of Lund, perfect for a leisurely stroll, picnic, or enjoying outdoor concerts in summer.

opening_hours.notes: Gates close at 22:00, park remains open.

places.place_tip: Bring a blanket and enjoy a picnic on the grass.

attribution.title: Lundagard 080508
attribution.author: Anton Holmquist Soasta

places.name: Domkyrkoplatsen Square
places.ai_summary: A historic square in front of Lund Cathedral, featuring cobblestone streets, benches, and a view of the cathedral’s façade.

opening_hours.notes: Public square, accessible at all times.

places.place_tip: Capture the best photos of the cathedral from the square.

places.name: AF Borgen Student Center
places.ai_summary: A vibrant student center at Lund University, offering dining, study spaces, and cultural activities.

opening_hours.notes: Hours may vary during holidays and semester breaks.

places.place_tip: Check out the student-run events and exhibitions.

places.name: Lund University Historical Museum
places.ai_summary: A museum showcasing the history of Lund University and its impact on education and research.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on public holidays.

places.place_tip: Visit the museum shop for unique university-themed souvenirs.

places.name: Ideon Science Park
places.ai_summary: A science park and business incubator, fostering innovation and collaboration between academia and industry.

opening_hours.notes: Access to certain areas may be restricted.

places.place_tip: Explore the outdoor art installations around the park.

places.name: Lund City Park
places.ai_summary: A spacious park in Lund, featuring walking paths, a pond, and a playground, ideal for families and outdoor activities.

opening_hours.notes: Gates close at 22:00, park remains open.

places.place_tip: Enjoy a boat ride on the pond during summer.

places.name: All Saints Church
places.ai_summary: A medieval church in Lund, known for its beautiful architecture, historic significance, and peaceful cemetery.

opening_hours.notes: Special hours during services and events.

places.place_tip: Explore the churchyard and the unique gravestones.

places.name: Rådhuset (City Hall)
places.ai_summary: The city hall of Lund, featuring impressive architecture and serving as a venue for weddings and official events.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on public holidays.

places.place_tip: Admire the building’s façade and the surrounding square.

places.name: Stadsbiblioteket (City Library)
places.ai_summary: The main city library of Lund, offering a vast collection of books, study spaces, and cultural events.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on public holidays.

places.place_tip: Join a guided tour to learn about the library’s history and architecture.

places.name: Mårtenstorget Market
places.ai_summary: A lively market square in Lund, hosting a popular market with local produce, crafts, and food stalls.

opening_hours.notes: Open on select holidays, check schedule.

places.place_tip: Try the local delicacies at the food stalls.

places.name: Dalby Söderskog National Park (day trip)
places.ai_summary: A national park located a short drive from Lund, featuring beautiful forests, trails, and a rich variety of wildlife.

opening_hours.notes: Visitor center open daily, trails open year-round.

places.place_tip: Visit the ancient beech forest and the scenic viewpoints.

places.name: Lund Art Gallery
places.ai_summary: An art gallery in Lund showcasing contemporary art exhibitions, installations, and cultural events.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on public holidays.

places.place_tip: Attend the opening receptions for new exhibitions.

places.name: Esplanaden Boulevard Walk
places.ai_summary: A scenic walking route along the canal in Lund, lined with trees, benches, and views of historic buildings.

opening_hours.notes: Public walkway, accessible at all times.

places.place_tip: Enjoy a coffee from a nearby café and take a leisurely stroll.

places.ai_summary: An art center in Lund focusing on contemporary art, offering exhibitions, workshops, and cultural events.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on public holidays.

places.place_tip: Participate in a workshop to experience art creation firsthand.
